liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Big River** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry sounds fiery from the opening Big River [15]
- **Friend of the Devil** (1 review): Reviewer enjoyed hearing the studio-style arrangement of Friend of the Devil rather than the usual live arrangement [14]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Reviewer calls Tennessee Jed excellent and the China Cat into Rider very trippy [6]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls Playin' frenetic and spaced-out, and the China Cat into Rider roaring [10]
- **Cryptical Envelopment** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Cryptical, Drums, Other One, Wharf Rat sequence massive; Sugar Magnolia and the closing run are very energetic [10]
- **Drums** (1 review): Reviewer praises Bill's solo drumming within the Cryptical, Drums, Other One, Wharf Rat sequence [14]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer prefers this Other One to the Stanley Theatre one; Jerry uses flanger and wah in a relentless, hard-hitting jam [6]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): The Other One into Wharf Rat, lacking the final verse, is excellent; Playin' is unimpressive and the first set lags [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **clear the aisles**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]
- **clear the orchestra pit**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **It's All Over Now Baby Blue**: back after 156 archived shows (685 days) [18]
- **clear the orchestra pit again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-09-23.170396.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac2496** (recommended): audience recording; 33 songs; 197 min [1]. Said about its sound: Lo-fi mono audience recording in antique condition, with dropouts [1]
- **gd72-09-23.sbd.jeffm.2201.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 30 songs; 200 min; rated 4.33/5 by 27 [3]. Said about its sound: Sound is just alright, with some tape hiss and a mediocre mix; Reviewer describes the sound as a warm soundboard; Soundboard has a nice Donna and Bobby vocal mix, Keith sounds good, and Garcia's guitar is intact [7][10][17]
- **gd1972-09-23.170395.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac1648**: audience recording; 33 songs; 197 min [2]
- **gd1972-09-23.sbd.130728.MrBill.flac16**: soundboard; 30 songs; 195 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this was their first of 103 shows, and walked back to brother's apartment vowing to see the band again [9]
- Reviewer saw Bobby's band at this venue and recalls it as a fire trap; it has since been renovated [11]
- Reviewer says the crowd was full of New Yorkers, giving the show the energy of a NYC concert [17]
- Reviewer ranks 9/23 and 9/24 among the better 1972 shows they have heard [7]
- Reviewer counts 9/23 and 9/24/72 among their favorite 1972 shows [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-09-23.170396.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac2496**: taped by Unknown from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by Matt Vernon, Mastering by Andrew F; source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation Medium Stock Brands: Maxell UD90 (120 uS EQ) [1]
- **gd72-09-23.sbd.jeffm.2201.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard lineage: master reel to cassette, then DAT, CDR, EAC, SHN, via Jeff M [3]
- **gd1972-09-23.170395.aud.lamarre.vernon.andrewF.flac1648**: taped by Unknown from the collection of Doug Lamarre; transferred by Matt Vernon, Mastering by Andrew F; source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation Medium Stock Brands: Maxell UD90 (120 uS EQ) [2]
- **gd1972-09-23.sbd.130728.MrBill.flac16**: transferred by Bill Guarneri; source: Recording Info: SBD > MR > C > DAT > CDR > SHN; Transfer Info: SHN > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Sonically enhanced, remastered, retracked upgrade of… [4]
